fullDescription: A minimalist, magazine-style mobile exploration interface featuring a sophisticated moss green and sunset orange palette. This design system, titled 'Wilderness Explorer', is optimized for outdoor, travel, and lifestyle applications. It utilizes high-contrast editorial typography (Cabinet Grotesk) and clean functional sans-serifs (Satoshi). Key features include a custom-textured map background, glassmorphism navigation bars, and elevated floating action buttons. Suitable for camping tools, real estate discovery, luxury travel guides, and boutique gear shops seeking an earthy yet premium aesthetic.

structured.summary: A sophisticated outdoor-inspired mobile design system featuring deep moss greens (#1a2f1a), vibrant sunset oranges (#c4785a), and soft ivory whites (#FAF8F5). The layout emphasizes a full-screen interactive map experience overlaid with floating high-contrast UI elements, magazine-style preview cards, and a tactile bottom navigation bar with an elevated central action button.

style.description: The style blends 'Outdoor Utility' with 'High-End Editorial'. It pairs bold, heavy-weight geometric headings with clean, wide-set body copy. The color palette is earthy and organic, using deep greens for grounding and warm oranges for interaction. Micro-interactions include organic bouncing markers and subtle pulsing glows for location awareness.
style.prompt:
### Visual Identity System

**Color Palette:**
- Primary (Moss Green): #1a2f1a (Used for text, toggles, and dark backgrounds)
- Accent (Sunset Orange): #c4785a (Used for location markers, call-to-actions, and highlights)
- Background (Ivory White): #FAF8F5 (Used for cards, base UI, and secondary text)
- Map Neutral: #eef2ee (For background canvas textures)

**Typography:**
- Headings: 'Cabinet Grotesk', bold (weight 800), letter-spacing: -0.02em. Use for titles and prominent labels.
- Body/Interface: 'Satoshi', regular to bold (400, 500, 700). Used for all functional text and metadata.

**Effects & Shading:**
- Shadow (Heavy): 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 10px 10px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)
- Shadow (Medium): 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)
- Glassmorphism: Background blur (8px) with 95% opacity white background for navigation.

**Animation:**
- Location Pulse: 1s ping animation on location markers (opacity: 0.2)
- Interaction: Scale transform (0.98) on active states for cards and buttons.
- Entrance: Map markers should have a subtle bounce animation (3-4s cycles) to indicate interactivity.

layout_and_structure.description: A layered mobile layout consisting of a full-screen interactive canvas, a top-floating toggle, a bottom-floating magazine card, and a fixed glassmorphism navigation bar.

prompts.prompt: Full viewport height background in #eef2ee. Apply a repeating dot grid texture (0.5px dots at 24px intervals) with 15% opacity. Overlay abstract, thin (1px) contour lines in #1a2f1a with 10% opacity. Place interactive circular markers (12px diameter) with white borders and varying categorical colors (green, blue, amber).

prompts.partPt: Menu do Topo Menu do Topo
prompts.prompt: Floating pill-shaped toggle centered at top. Height: 44px. Background: #1a2f1a. Contains two toggle buttons with rounded-full corners. Active state: #FAF8F5 background with #1a2f1a text. Inactive state: white text at 60% opacity. Shadow: 2xl.

Floating horizontal card positioned 110px from bottom. White background, 24px corner radius. Left side: Square image container (1/3 width) with category tag overlay (#1a2f1a/80 background). Right side: Content area with vertical flex layout. Top section includes a title in Cabinet Grotesk and an accent icon. Bottom section includes metadata row with small icons and 10px bold uppercase tracking-wider text.

Glassmorphism bar (95% white, 8px blur) with 32px corner radius. Fixed to bottom with 34px safe area padding. Height: 64px. Features three slots: Left/Right for standard navigation links (icon + 10px label), and a central elevated button. Central button: 56px diameter, #c4785a background, white icon, 4px ivory border, positioned half-out of the bar top.

special_ui_components.description: A vibrant, layered location marker indicating user position.
special_ui_components.prompt: A composite component consisting of three layers: 1. A bottom-most pulsing ring (#c4785a, 32px diameter, 20% opacity, animate-ping). 2. A central 16px circle (#c4785a). 3. A 2px solid white border and a soft shadow for depth.

special_ui_components.description: Small, high-contrast category labels for images.
special_ui_components.prompt: Pill-shaped label with 8px horizontal padding and 2px vertical padding. Background: #1a2f1a at 80% opacity with backdrop-blur. Text: White, font-size 10px, font-family Satoshi Bold.

structured.special_notes: MUST: Maintain high contrast between Ivory White and Moss Green for legibility. DO: Use uppercase for secondary metadata to enhance the 'magazine' look. DO NOT: Use standard blue for links; stick to the brand orange or green. MUST: Use significant padding (at least 24px) on card edges to maintain a premium, spacious feel.
